== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 3)]], showing the '''PC-E3''' game text. '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip, the Players Committee card image and the Master List slip show other texts of this card.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list, as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html); 12 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType). The list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E3 text:''' “If your starting location was a system, ▼ a related site (must be a battleground if the system is a non-battleground or Endor) with < 3 [Light Side Force] icons and up to three Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
